title: Constructible sheaf of modules on the small etale site
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, let $T_{\Et}$ be the small etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\Lambda_T$ its constant sheaf of rings, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The sheaf $\mathcal F$ is *constructible* if there is a stratification $(\iota_k\colon Z_k\to T)_{k<n}$ of the scheme $T$ [def-constructible-stratification] (a finite partition $T=\coprod_{k<n}T_k$ of the underlying space into pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets, a partition in the sense of Stacks 09XZ with no condition on closures of strata, together with immersions $\iota_k$ of schemes $Z_k$ with set-theoretic image $T_k$) such that
(a) every stratum $T_k$ is a constructible subset of the underlying space of $T$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], and
(b) for every $k$ the inverse image $\iota_k^{-1}\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], a sheaf of $\Lambda_{Z_k}$-modules on $(Z_k)_{\Et}$, is *finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules* (Stacks 03RU): it is locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-locally-constant] with finite values, i.e. there are an etale covering $\{U_i\to Z_k\}_{i\in I}$ and finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ (finite as sets; $\Lambda$ being finite, equivalently finitely generated) such that $(\iota_k^{-1}\mathcal F)|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$, the constant sheaf of $\Lambda_{U_i}$-modules with value $M_i$, for every $i$.
The schemes $Z_k$ are part of the data; one may take $Z_k=T_k$ with its reduced induced structure (Stacks, paragraph before 03RW).

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma Tag 095E, condition (3) (label lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), the form for sheaves of Lambda-modules over a Noetherian ring Lambda, here Lambda finite; the partition is Topology Definition 09XZ (topology-definition-paritition); finite locally constant as in Definition Tag 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant), with finite values; for quasi-compact quasi-separated T equivalent to Definition Tag 03RW(3) (label definition-constructible), see the pointer lem-weil-pbc-constructible-qcqs-affine-local. The global form is the constructibility clause of literature/blueprint/master/blueprint/sec-proper-base-change/sk-thm-p1/def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes.md

proof.text: (Data: the strata.) A stratification $(\iota_k:Z_k\to T)_{k<n}$ of the scheme $T$ in the sense of [def-constructible-stratification]: a finite family of pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets $T_k$ covering $T$ and immersions $\iota_k$ with image $T_k$. Condition (a) asks each $T_k$ to be a constructible subset of $|T|$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] (Mathlib's Topology.IsConstructible); this is what distinguishes the notion from [def-constructible-constructible], whose strata are only locally closed.

source.place: Lemma 095E, condition (3); the paragraph before Definition 03RW ('constructible locally closed subscheme')

proof.text: (The restriction to a stratum.) For each $k$ the inverse image functor along $\iota_k$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] sends the sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] to a sheaf of $\Lambda_{Z_k}$-modules on $(Z_k)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] (the coefficient ring pulls back to itself, as recorded in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]); this is the '$\mathcal F|_{X_i}$' of Stacks.

(The condition on a stratum.) Condition (b) is local constancy as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-locally-constant] (coefficient category the $\Lambda$-modules), with all constant values $M_i$ finite $\Lambda$-modules: Stacks 03RU's 'finite locally constant' (finite values). That this is the same as [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant] for $\Lambda$-modules (locally constant with finite geometric stalks, the Lean IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf) and as Stacks 03RW(3)'s 'of finite type and locally constant' is the pointer lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values, not part of the definition.

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks 095E(3), 03RW(3), 03RU and Topology 09XZ. Made the data precise: a 'stratification' here is a 09XZ partition (finite, locally closed, disjoint; no closure condition), strata constructible, inverse image a Lambda_{Z_k}-module sheaf; finite locally constant is now said once, in Stacks 03RU form: etale-locally isomorphic to constant sheaves of finite Lambda-modules M_i (the old text said 'a Lambda-module M_i' and separately 'stalks finite'). Statement dependency def-constructible-finite-locally-constant (finite-stalk form) replaced by def-constructible-locally-constant (the condition is local constancy with finite values); the agreement of the two forms, and with 03RW(3)'s 'finite type and locally constant', is moved to the new statement node lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values. Claims moved out into statement nodes kept in pointers (not stmt_deps): lem-weil-pbc-constructible-qcqs-affine-local (Stacks 095E: equivalence with the affine-local 03RW for qcqs T; no 095E node existed), lem-weil-pbc-constructible-change-of-ring (restriction of scalars along Lambda->Lambda' surjective; used inline by steps 6-7 of lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-reduction), lem-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion-modules-agree (bridge to def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion on curves, needed by prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension step 10); independence of the choice of Z_k is the existing closed node lemma-constructible-immersion-independence (pointer). Construction written as three elementary steps naming the notions. Lean: slopmaster2 AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf (ConstructibleSheaf/Defs.lean 249-251, sorry-free, reaches no sorry) with A = ModuleCat Lambda is NOT the same: its Scheme.Stratification (Defs.lean 204-216, over Topology.Stratification) does not require the strata to be constructible, and its finiteness is finite stalks (IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf, Defs.lean 193-198) rather than finite values; so the node is not closed by it.
